description: PlaceSchema: identity and items that travel between games. POST /v1/grant {grant, holder?} checks a signed item grant (Nostr kind-30080) offline and returns holder, minter, item hash, type, label and licensed sources. POST /v1/place {url} checks a PlaceSchema place and what items it accepts. POST /v1/player {name|pubkey} resolves a player by name or key to a verified identity. POST /v1/places {hub} lists a hub's worlds and which it trusts items from. POST /v1/look {grant, caps, slots?} picks the look a game client should draw for an item (model by sha256, slot and size, or a stand-in). POST /v1/stash {holder} lists what a key reports holding. JSON in and out; bad input is 4xx, never 5xx. Free.

rpc_types.backend_hint: Caddy proxy (placeschema/backend) to the Cloudflare Worker at https://verify.placeschema.com
rpc_types.notes: GET /v1/version, GET /v1/health, GET /openapi.json; POST /v1/grant, /v1/place, /v1/look (pure) and /v1/player, /v1/places, /v1/stash (live registrar or relay state).

serving.backend: The placeschema/verify Worker behind a RelayMiner using the rest backend.
serving.notes: Pure calls (look, grant, place) are limited to 600 POSTs per 60 s per client IP; live calls (player, cached 60 s; places, cached 15 s; stash) to 60. Relays share the supplier's IP, so these are the caps per supplier.
